rules: #minimap { position: absolute; top: 22px; right: 22px; width: 240px; height: 240px; border: 2px solid var(--c); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(rgba(10, 20, 70, 0.8), rgba(3, 5, 22, 0.85)); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(25, 230, 255, 0.5); overflow: hidden; }
sample_region: PNG pixel centers within radius88 of minimap center, gridstep8; interior excludes frame/text-edge/shadow-dominant pixels. No runtime/distance culling change.
gradient_origin: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) radial-gradient(rgba(10, 20, 70, 0.8), rgba(3, 5, 22, 0.85)) repeat scroll 0% 0% / auto padding-box border-box
scope: CRC-checked standard-library decoding of known-manifest prepared static Chrome PNG; current relevant CSS unchanged. CPU raylib36-fan interpolation model, not native framebuffer/pixel, border/glow, whole-disk or performance acceptance.
